# forensic-lab Copilot Instructions

Read `PROJECT_CONTEXT.md` and `AGENTS.md` first. They are the repo-level source
of truth for project context and coding-agent behavior.

Keep changes small, inspect the relevant code before editing, and follow the
path-scoped instruction files under `.github/instructions/` when they apply.

Do not duplicate project architecture, CLI details, scenario status, or VM
lifecycle details here. Update `PROJECT_CONTEXT.md` or `AGENTS.md` instead if
repo-wide instruction truth needs to change.
